notes: Noi tru: tach buoc Yeu cau xuat vien (chot chi phi TRUOC khi nhap phieu ra vien) + chong vong chet chot chi phi <-> ra vien; chuyen khoa N5 het vo 500; menu Cho nhap vien rieng, man BN noi tru doi ten thanh Quan ly noi tru; bang ke gom ca chi phi phat sinh truoc khi nhap buong. Quyen: cap du menu+quyen noi tru cho bac si/dieu duong/truong khoa (truoc day DOCTOR co menu ma khong co mot quyen inpatient nao, dieu duong khong nhan duoc benh vao khoa). Phieu cham soc 38/BV1: dau phieu het trong ho ten/khoa/phong/giuong; sua duoc theo tung dong, them lan cham soc luon bam duoc ke ca khi da chot. Chuc nang song: cot theo TUNG LAN DO, het ghep lan hai lan do trong cung gio. CDHA/XN: mot modal ket qua dung chung, o Gio thuc hien, canh bao thieu may sau khi tra ket qua, khoa o nhap cho toi khi bam Bat dau thuc hien. XML BHYT: XML5 them dong dien bien luc ra vien cho dot ngoai tru dai ngay va bam gio BAT DAU cho PT/TT; MA_MAY dong PT/TT lay tu phieu tuong trinh; NGAY_VAO cua XML7/XML8 bam gio vao dot KCB; XML2 noi tru tach LIEU_DUNG khoi CACH_DUNG; XML3 SO_LUONG khong con rung phan thap phan; ma noi bo khong con chui vao field ma BHYT lam vo ca me. Sua 500 cam khi ke y lenh thuoc noi tru va khi luu dich vu PT/TT (thieu khai quan he EF). Xoa du lieu: CASCADE dong nhat cho moi bang dan xuat, xoa y lenh keo theo dien bien nen khong con ro len XML5. Ky so: them man Con dau to chuc (eSeal).
